skills.name: diskcache-oxide
skills.description: Use diskcache-oxide, a shared, durable disk cache for Python with a Rust engine, SQLite storage and python-diskcache's API, built for many threads, many worker processes and free-threaded CPython. Use when adding or configuring diskcache_oxide in an app (Cache, FanoutCache, NullCache, Caches), switching code from diskcache, choosing between Cache and FanoutCache or between raising, missing and switching caching off, writing tests around a cache, or when code raises Timeout, TransactionBusy, UnsafeValueError, CorruptValueError, LayoutMismatchError, FormatMismatchError, or "can't be stored without pickle".
